scope: Isolated diagnostics only, no default enablement, rejection threshold, fusion or production changes
inputs: Frozen manifest.json/config.json and exactly matching baseline JPEG previews
runtime: PyIQA 0.1.16, torch 2.14.0, CPU, batch 1, four torch threads, separate process per model
metrics: strict proxy pairwise accuracy with ties/unknown excluded
top1 in each proxy preferred set
limitations: No rejection or fusion policy is calibrated by this experiment. Proxy results do not establish human acceptance. If evidence minima or resource limits fail, retain baseline and stop candidate promotion. RAW inference transform is frozen but is not a substitute for full-resolution focus review.
